title: V2 migration mints into disabled V2 dispatchers (mintFor ignores `disabled` flag)
description: `mintFor(index, recipient)` checks only `configs[index].dispatcher != address(0)`, not `!configs[index].disabled`. The paid-mint path (`_executeMint`) correctly enforces `!config.disabled` at line 174. Since NFTMigrator is an authorized minter and calls `mintFor`, an owner who disables a V2 dispatcher to stop new entitlement cannot actually stop NFTMigrator from minting into that index during migration.
impact: Owner intent (disabling a V2 dispatcher) is bypassed, inflating V2 supply in categories the owner explicitly halted. Mint-cap bypass.
attack_path: User holding V1 NFTs mapped to v2Index calls migrate().
Check passes, NFT minted despite disabled flag.
recommendation: In `mintFor`, add `require(!configs[index].disabled, "...")`, matching `_executeMint`. Alternatively add a separate "migration allowed" flag per index.
